kind: gen_input (VASP force-calculation deck + undisplaced 4x4x1 supercell POSCAR)
provenance: rubric and structure reference from 3_reproduction/L9/ (finite-displacement phonon reproduction, 2026-07-10); see ../../../3_reproduction/L9/index.md and result.json
graded_object: the shared single-point force deck (INCAR/KPOINTS) applied to every displaced supercell, plus the UNDISPLACED 4x4x1 supercell POSCAR. The displacement generation is route-dependent (phonopy version/settings) and is NOT graded; the electronic deck and the base supercell ARE route-invariant. See notes.md for the displacement-uniqueness resolution.
structure_reference: reference/supercell_undisplaced/POSCAR symlinks the as-run undisplaced 4x4x1 supercell (3_reproduction/L9/hpc_computations/dfpt_dry/POSCAR, the SPOSCAR phonopy built from the relaxed unit cell). The submitted POSCAR is matched against it.

structure_match.note: monolayer, non-polar, single mirror-symmetric layer; Ru/Cl binary with distinct counts (16 vs 32), no sublattice-swap or layer-order ambiguity, so the StructureMatcher path is safe. Verified in selfcheck.py: passes the reference and a pymatgen-built 4x4x1 supercell, fails wrong-lattice / wrong-supercell-size / wrong-basis variants.

encut_catalog: graderlib/grader_potcar_vasp54.yaml (Ru_pv 230.429, Cl 280.000 eV). ENCUT floor = 1.0 * max(ENMAX) = 280 eV.

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

declared_pins.note: printed in the prompt because physics + staged files + catalog cannot determine them; graded as consistency with the printed value (see notes.md 'Declared pins' + necessity tests).

hubbard_U_eV.shell: Ru 4d (l=2), Dudarev U_eff=LDAUU-LDAUJ; no effective Cl correction

declared_pins.magnetic_treatment: collinear ferromagnetic (ISPIN=2, FM seed), spin-orbit coupling off (no LSORBIT)

incar_required.note: Only these effective settings are graded. LMAXMIX is ungraded for this standalone force deck; 4 remains the reproduction choice. No fixed-density handoff or startup files are inferred.
incar_required.static: no ionic motion: NSW effectively 0 (default 0) or IBRION=-1
incar_required.ENCUT_floor: ENCUT >= max ENMAX over Ru_pv,Cl = 280 eV (pseudopotential floor); REQUIRED-explicit, an absent ENCUT fails
incar_required.EDIFF_floor: EDIFF <=1e-5 eV grading ceiling; as-run value 1e-7 eV. This floor is not an independently measured force-convergence bound.
incar_required.ISMEAR_set: ISMEAR in {-5, 0} (gapped FM insulator; -5 admissible since the 3x3x1 mesh samples 2 axes)
incar_required.ISPIN2: ISPIN effectively 2 (collinear spin-polarized; default 1 fails) -- consistency with the pinned collinear-FM treatment
incar_required.MAGMOM_FM: If explicit, NIONS finite scalar moments after repetition expansion. Entries with |m|>=0.5 must exist and share one sign. Omission retains the default FM seed. No seed-convergence guarantee or runtime magnetic-density check.
incar_required.LSORBIT_off: LSORBIT effectively .FALSE. (default; a noncollinear SOC deck LSORBIT=.TRUE. fails) -- consistency with the pinned SOC-off treatment
incar_required.LASPH_true: LASPH=.TRUE. (open Ru-4d shell + DFT+U aspherical gradient terms; default .FALSE.)
incar_required.LDAU_block: LDAU true; LDAUTYPE effectively 2. LDAUL/LDAUU/LDAUJ arrays follow POSCAR species order; omitted J defaults to zero. Ru l=2 and U-J=2.0+/-0.2 eV. Cl l=-1 or effective U within 0.2 eV of zero.
incar_required.kmesh: Frozen automatic-default minima from kmesh_policy, with the separately specified centering, vacuum and method constraints.
incar_required.LNONCOLLINEAR_off: LNONCOLLINEAR effectively false, including omission; required by the collinear treatment.

score: 1 only if the single supercell_forces run passes the structure match AND every INCAR/KPOINTS REQUIRED check (binary all-primary-pass; any single failure scores 0)

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
